items.q: The idea of Mr. Sims, as I've seen it helpful later, and Mr. Langford together

ctx.x: Oh, that's how you come to be--you didn't really have a preference.

Not really. The idea of Mr. Sims, as I've seen it helpful later, and Mr. Langford together and they were selfer, not forceful. You had a choice which does make a difference. We had a choice to do these things and it came out pretty good. We had to go to swimming earlier. Band rehearsal would come around 1 o'clock in the day and that was our swimming time, the time we'd go swimming. It was hot out there in the summertime in Webster Groves, Missouri. So then we'd have to go swimming earlier because we had to make a…
Of course, the uniforms were a big thing with kids, always weren't they?
